description: Prepare for a double vanity installation by clearing the bathroom, deciding on all fixtures, and disclosing any known plumbing or electrical issues.

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before Hometelligent Inc. begins a double vanity installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before Hometelligent Inc. begins your double vanity installation, we recommend clearing the bathroom of personal items and ensuring clear access to the work area. If removing an old vanity, plan for its disposal. We also advise making final decisions on your vanity, faucets, and any associated lighting or mirrors, as having these items on-site or readily available prevents project delays. Additionally, consider disclosing any known issues with existing plumbing or electrical systems during our initial consultation, which allows us to anticipate and plan for potential complexities, ensuring a smoother process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for a double vanity installation by clearing the bathroom, deciding on all fixtures, and disclosing any known plumbing or electrical issues.
